blocks.translation:
• Warning — Read this before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to anyone younger than the indicated age.
• This product contains small parts and batteries. Keep it away from young children so they cannot accidentally swallow anything. There is a risk of choking.
• There are pointed and sharp parts. Take care when handling and storing the product, as it may cause unexpected injury.
• Take care that fingers, hair, or clothing do not get caught in rotating parts.
• Do not use the product near the ear. Accidental use near the ear may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, do not bring this product close to your body.
• Using batteries incorrectly can cause heating, explosion, or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Do not use secondary (rechargeable) batteries under any circumstances.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
• Install batteries with the correct +/− (polarity).
• After playing, always turn the power off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into the eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If fluid contacts skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipality's waste-disposal instructions.
